meaning: CS_RMAX=100 bounds the neural compliance multiplier through exp(log(CS_RMAX)·tanh(z)), so learned spinal compliance can range from 1/100x to 100x the per-patient M1-fitted value. The comment justifies 100 by citing an earlier unconstrained run that reached 0.15x to 70x of Marmarou.
expectation: The bound sets how far training can move from the M1 starting point. A tighter CS_RMAX keeps M7 closer to M1 (higher loss, more physiological); 100 admits near-degenerate compliance. Magnitude unknown from this context.

could_move.what: Fitted compliance trajectories and loss, since nn_factor is the only path from the network into spinal compliance
M1-vs-M7 comparison figures for patient 081, whose M7 curve comes from this bounded law

check.why: Shows every use of the bound and whether the cited 0.15x-70x and 0.224 numbers are recorded anywhere in the file, before paying for a re-fit.
